answer_1.quote: We propose the novel concept, Visual Knowledge Card (VKC), which is essentially a process that creates a new image by editing the scene graph (based on visual entities detected from the input image) with external knowledge obtained from LLM (considered as a domain expert).
answer_1.outputs: Visual Knowledge Card (VKC), a knowledge-enhanced image generated by integrating external knowledge into a scene image for visual reasoning.
